examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{起|お}きてください。
もっと{早|はや}く{歩|ある}いて。
{早|はや}く{元気|げんき}になってね。
{今日|きょう}は{早|はや}く{家|いえ}を{出|で}ました。
examples.english: I left the house early today.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{寝|ね}た{方|ほう}がいいですよ。
examples.english: You should go to bed early.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}{早|はや}く{起|お}きるのは{苦手|にがて}です。
examples.english: I'm not good at getting up early in the morning.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{予定|よてい}より{早|はや}く{終|お}わりました。
examples.english: The meeting ended earlier than scheduled.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{走|はし}れないんです。
もっと{早|はや}く{食|た}べてください。
{電車|でんしゃ}が{来|き}たので、{早|はや}く{乗|の}ってください。
examples.english: The train is here, so please get on quickly.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}がないので{早|はや}く{準備|じゅんび}して。
examples.english: We don't have time, so get ready quickly.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{春|はる}になってほしい。
examples.english: I want spring to come soon.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}くお{会|あ}いしたいです。
examples.english: I want to see you soon.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたいなあ。
examples.english: I really want to go to Japan soon.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{終|お}わらせて{帰|かえ}りましょう。
examples.english: Let's finish soon and go home.

notes:
{早|はや}く is the adverb form of {早|はや}い.

BASE ADJECTIVE:
- {早|はや}い (early, fast)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {早|はや}く{起|お}きる (to wake up early)
- {早|はや}く{帰|かえ}る (to go home early)
- できるだけ{早|はや}く (as soon as possible)

DISTINCTION:
- {早|はや}い can mean both "early" and "fast"
- {速|はや}い specifically means "fast" (speed)
